description: Source code defining CUDA kernel classes, including CUDAKernel, CUDATemplateKernel, and caller classes for CUDA templates, with methods for kernel signature, invocation, and layout management.

classes.name: LayoutArg
classes.description: Immutable data class representing layout argument with node, symbol, attribute, and dimension.

classes.name: CUDAKernel
classes.description: Base class for CUDA / Cutlass kernels, managing layout args, size args, and IR nodes.

classes.name: CUDATemplateKernel
classes.description: Template kernel class defined by CUDA / Cutlass in C++, with methods for signature, kernel call, and dtype handling.

classes.name: CUDATemplateCaller
classes.description: Caller class for CUDA template kernels, managing benchmarking, kernel invocation, and metadata.

methods.name: _normalize_idx

methods.description: Finds the symbol associated with a node, attribute, and dimension.

methods.description: Finds layout argument matching node, attribute, and dimension.
